provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: El Grande rules (Hans im Gluck / Rio Grande, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Castillo on its space; mobile scoreboards beside the board
Shuffle the 9 region cards; turn up the top one and place the King there
Each player draws a region card: that is their home region, where their Grande goes
Each player takes 10 Caballeros: 2 by their Grande, 1 on the first space of the success track, 7 in their court
Each player: a secret disk and their 13 power cards
Action cards sorted by back into stacks 1-5 (the 5 stack is just the King card); shuffle each facedown
Players choose who plays the first power card; the highest power card then takes the first turn
